transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I'm here today because I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for the past four weeks. It feels like a heavy weight I can't lift, and I just can't shake this constant low mood.
Have you experienced any periods of elevated mood, irritability, or increased energy in the past, or has your mood been consistently low?

No, I haven't had any periods of high energy or elevated mood at all. My mood has just been consistently low and deeply depressed for the past four weeks. There are no high points or times when I've felt irritable or unusually energetic.
Have you experienced any unusual thoughts, heard voices, or seen things that others cannot see or hear during this period of feeling depressed?

Yes, I've actually been having some very strange thoughts, and sometimes I hear voices or see things that aren't really there. These frightening experiences only ever happen when I am feeling this deeply depressed.
Have you ever experienced these strange thoughts, heard voices, or seen things when you weren't feeling depressed, or do they only occur during your depressive episodes?
No, I've never had those experiences when my mood was normal. They only ever happen when I am in this deep, dark depression. When I'm not depressed, my mind is completely clear of those things.
Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these episodes of depression, and whether they've been recurring over time or if this is your first episode?

I've been experiencing these depressive symptoms for about four weeks now. This is actually my very first time going through an episode like this, as I don't have any history of feeling this way before.
For how long have the strange thoughts, voices, or visions been present in relation to your current four-week depressive episode, and have they lasted throughout or come and gone?

They started right around the same time I began feeling depressed four weeks ago. Since then, they have come and gone, but they only happen when I am in this dark state. They haven't existed outside of these past four weeks.

Can you think of any periods, even briefly, where you had those strange thoughts, heard voices, or saw things without being depressed at the same time, or have they always been tied to your depressive episodes?

No, they have always been completely tied to my depression. I have never experienced those voices or visions during times when my mood was normal or okay. They only seem to show up when I am in this deep darkness.

Have you had any periods, no matter how brief, where you felt okay or your depression lifted for a bit, but the strange thoughts, voices, or visions continued, or do they always stop when your depression improves?

No, they never continue if my mood starts to lift. Whenever I've had even a brief moment of feeling slightly better, those voices and visions completely stop. They are only present when I am in the deepest part of my depression.
Just to confirm, you're saying that the strange thoughts, voices, or visions only occur when you're deeply depressed and always stop when your mood improves, even if only slightly, is that correct?

Yes, that is exactly correct. Those strange thoughts, voices, and visions only happen when I am at my absolute lowest and feeling deeply depressed. If my mood improves even a little bit, they completely go away.

It seems we've covered all the necessary information. Based on what you've shared, I believe I can make an accurate diagnosis and recommend a treatment plan for you. Would you like me to proceed with discussing the diagnosis and potential treatment options?
Yes, please. I would really appreciate it if you could explain the diagnosis and tell me about the treatment options so I can start finding some relief.
